name: Mount Paran
line: Mount Paran is a mountain, probably in the hilly wilderness south of the Promised Land, named in two poems about God coming in glory.

moments.title: God shines from Paran
moments.text: In his blessing before he died, Moses said the LORD came from Sinai and shone forth from Mount Paran. He came with many thousands of holy ones and flaming fire at His right hand.

moments.title: The Holy One from Paran
moments.text: In his prayer, Habakkuk said that God came from Teman, and the Holy One came from Mount Paran. His glory covered the heavens, and His praise filled the earth.
